1) CHARACTER: Long silver/white hair, straight bangs, pale skin; crimson/red eyes, half-lidded gaze; slim build; large dark ribbed ram horns wrapped with red ribbon; no visible fangs/marks.

2) CLOTHING STATE: Dark ribbed/knit garment (dark blue-black), off-shoulder; covers chest and torso; shoulders, collarbones, neck fully bare; one shoulder strap slipped down arm; no thigh/hip/stomach visible (submerged). No discernible nipple shape or under-fabric detail.

3) POSE: Reclining in water, head tilted up and back; right arm raised, hand gloved/sleeved covering mouth/chin area; left arm submerged/obscured; legs not visible (underwater).

4) CAMERA: Upper-body/portrait framing, slight face emphasis; low-ish angle near water level, roughly eye-level to tilted face; slight tilt but no pronounced dutch.

5) SCENE: Nighttime outdoor pool or hot-spring at a rooftop/edge with city lights bokeh in background; glowing blue water, caustic light patterns; strong blue rim/key lighting with warm accents on skin and red glowing eye highlight.

6) RATING VERDICT: PG-13 — chest covered, bare shoulders only, no erotic emphasis or fabric tease.

7) ACID/LSD THEME: No — lighting is bioluminescent/night-pool aesthetic; no kaleidoscope, prisms, rainbow oil slicks, or melting/hallucinatory patterns.
